sourceText:
PBTfans Pelican Keycaps are inspired by the long beak flying creatures. Characterizing the keycaps with its black and beige feathers and yellow beak.
Inspiration:
Pelicans (genus Pelecanus) are a genus of large water birds that make up the family Pelecanidae. They are characterized by a long beak and a large throat pouch used for catching prey and draining water from the scooped-up contents before swallowing.
The colorway inspiration was captured from the Pelican standing on the lake at sunset. I pick yellow to represent its significant beak, black and beige for the feather, and pink for unnoticeable details.
The Pelican looks so good under the sunset, providing a remain aloof-from-the-world vibe without opening its beak.
